title.narrative: Wahab & Co to review RHSTEP and BAPSA
Wahab & Co to review RHSTEP and BAPSA

description.narrative: EMB i Sverige Dhaka avser att genomföra en utvärdering av institutionella- och ekonomiska förvaltningskapaciteten hos RHSTEP och BAPSA, inklusive kapacitet inom internkontroll och förvaltning enligt bifogad ToR bilaga 1 innan undertecknande av avtalet med RHSTEP och BAPSA för perioden 2017-2021, Taget från bidraget nr 10757. EMB / Dhaka med stöd av Wahab och Co. genomför översikten genom ramavtalet mellan ambassaden och Wahab och Co.

EMB of Sweden Dhaka intends to conduct an assesment of institutional and financial management capacity of RHSTEP and BAPSA which includes internal control and management according to attached ToR appendix 1 before signing the agreement with RHSTEP and BAPSA for the period of 2017-2021 , taken from the contribution No 10757. EMB/Dhaka with the support of Wahab and Co. carries thorugh the review via frame work agreement between the Embassy and Wahab and Co.

The primary aim of the intervention was to assess the financialand institutional capacity of RHSTEP and BAPSA while engaging in a new agreement with them. The reportinformed the Embassy about the financial management and procurement system of the organizations includinginternal control system which contributed a lot to prepare the appraisal document and the decision.The intervention has fulfilled its purpose.The report was submitted on time.
No indicator available - only a description of the activity results is published
